Updated assessment incorporating the Financial Stability Report (FSR): The statement’s tone remains cautiously optimistic—economic activity and employment are strengthening, policy is still highly accommodative via forward guidance and sizable (though tapering) asset purchases, and the Committee is prepared to adjust if inflation persists. However, the FSR highlights elevated asset valuations and compressed risk premiums, lingering vulnerabilities in nonbank funding markets, and still‑high business leverage—all of which could amplify shocks. While banks appear well capitalized and overall financial conditions remain accommodative, these vulnerabilities, alongside pandemic and supply‑constraint uncertainties, temper the outlook. Net: slightly positive but more guarded than before.
